_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Not knowing short lines for a hotel

segments.text: Checking in at a hotel? Here are four easy lines. Repeat after me.

native.caption: ¿Te da vergüenza hablar en inglés en el hotel? Guarda estas 4 frases, como “I have a reservation.” y “Where can I eat breakfast?”. Escucha a Ama y repite tú en la pausa. Practica más en la app Lexkite.

en.hook: What do you say at a hotel?
en.caption: Shy about speaking English at the hotel? Save these 4 lines, such as “I have a reservation.” and “Where can I eat breakfast?” Listen to Ama and repeat in the pause. Practice more in the Lexkite app.
